title: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
summary: Gain +1 Strength saves. Deal damage using a qualifying weapon attack spell to gain 2 turns of Arcane Acuity.

fields.Qualifying attacks: Includes smites, Booming Blade, Ensnaring Strike, Hail of Thorns, and Shadow Blade weapon attacks. Normal conjured Flame Blade in the main hand can trigger it from other damage sources.
fields.Arcane Acuity: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC per remaining turn, up to 10 turns. Taking damage removes 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 290 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported triggers: Damage while wielding a temporary Druid Flame Blade in your main hand can trigger this. An off-hand, permanent, or Mephistopheles racial Flame Blade does not qualify. Throwing healing potions or grenades can trigger this even without hitting a target. Retaliation damage does not qualify.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
